name: kalo
description: AI coding agent desktop client, built on the pi agent engine (https://github.com/earendil-works/pi)

scripts.setup: cd kalo-harness && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build && cd ../kalo-desktop && npm install
scripts.dev: bun scripts/ensure-engine.mjs && bun run --cwd kalo-desktop tauri dev
scripts.build: bun scripts/ensure-engine.mjs && bun run --cwd kalo-desktop tauri build
